recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If diagrams are regenerated in a future publication workflow, the stale Condition.evidence SVG tooltip can be refreshed from the authoritative XML source, but no FHIR core source correction is needed for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-42981 asked Patient Care to clarify Condition.evidence so it could cover supporting evidence for determining the condition, including severity-related evidence, while adding guidance not to use Condition.evidence for causality.
initial_application: Commit c71dae0dd9384f14d337a2251452dbdac2f6ea14 applied J#42981 by updating source/condition/structuredefinition-Condition.xml with the requested short text, broader definition, and causality comment. The same historical commit also included separate J#42978 Condition.onset edits.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists condition=Condition as an active resource, so the StructureDefinition source is in current build scope. The linked Patient Care WG Zulip thread supports the interpretation that evidence should be broader than verification status. The condition-dueTo extension referenced by the source is present in the FHIR Extension Pack. The checked-in Condition SVG still has an older tooltip, but it is a generated-looking artifact rather than the authoritative source.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the authoritative current Condition StructureDefinition already contains the Jira-approved text and the remaining stale SVG tooltip should not be fixed as a generated-artifact-only reconciliation.

related_jiras.note: Condition.onset was implemented in the same historical commit as FHIR-42981, but it concerns a separate element and was not needed to decide the seed issue.
